name: text-system-last
notes: a system message that ends the conversation: the engine's copy of the encoder writes it as bare text and opens the assistant turn after it, where the checkpoint's own encoder file opens the turn after user and developer turns only

name: text-system-before-assistant
notes: a system message an assistant turn follows: the engine's copy of the encoder opens that history turn after it (a system message a user turn follows stays bare text, as text-system-after-user shows)
